name: field-finance-payout-governance
objective: إغلاق مالية الميداني على WLT: destination read-only للمستفيد، provisioning وmaker/checker/versioning محكوم، FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED server-side، idempotency/unknown-result reconciliation وعقد مشترك غير قابل للتجاوز.
truthOwner: WLT owns representative ledger, payout destination, payout request, reservation, provider execution and reconciliation.

tasks.objective: Harden the entire representative payout authority and close field provisioning/approval/reconciliation gaps without reintroducing manual beneficiary input.
tasks.currentProblem: UI has moved toward read-only destination and amount modes, but closure requires proof that backend aliases, provisioning, maker/checker, immutable version pinning and provider reconciliation are all authoritative and non-bypassable.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace all field/partner/captain payout destination routes and writers, remove self-mutation paths, implement/finish WLT provisioning and approval workflow, resolve destination/eligible balance server-side, pin destination version, and harden idempotent unknown-result reconciliation.
tasks.targetState: Beneficiary apps can only read masked active destination and request full/specified payout; Finance alone changes verified destination through audited approval; every payout resolves one WLT-owned destination/version and one eligible amount exactly once.
tasks.action: Inventory WLT/DSH contracts, routes, DB/state/events and all related Finance pages/tabs; migrate/remove obsolete self-service paths, implement maker/checker and provisioning, add cross-actor/security/provider-fault tests, and verify ledger inspector only where field readback is causal.
mustNotChange: لا beneficiary destination input في Field/Partner/Captain.
لا جلب COD/payment-session scope دون causal evidence.
لا blind retry عند provider result unknown.
acceptanceCriteria: لا self-service destination mutation route قابلة للوصول للمستفيدين.
initial provisioning/change يمران WLT Finance authority وaudit/versioning.
FULL_AVAILABLE يحسب eligible amount server-side وSPECIFIED يتحقق منه.
كل Finance pages/tabs ذات الصلة تعكس same payout/destination truth.
Partner/Captain shared contract لا يتراجع دون إدخال ميزاتهما غير المرتبطة.
tasks.rollback: Financial state uses forward-fix only; never restore self-service destination mutation or release unknown reservations blindly.
tasks.commitBoundary: One coherent WLT/DSH finance authority batch with required surface changes.
